 For Petitioner : Mr.R.Rameshraja

 Additional Government Pleader

For R3 : Mr.Su.Srinivasan

 Order

The petitioner has come to this Court seeking a writ of mandamus to direct the first respondent to dispose of his claim petition dated 04.07.2023, challenging the award dated 30.06.2022 passed by the second respondent, within a specified time frame.
2. It is the case of the petitioner that his land, comprised in survey No.577/1B measuring 590 sq.ft.
at Thorapalli Agraharam https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Village, Hosur Taluk, Krishnagiri District, had been acquired by the authorities without paying proper compensation.

He would submit that the land had been used for cultivating carrot, beetroot, cabbage, cauliflower and other vegetables and also had three coconut trees, 5 Nilgiri trees, as well as two borewells - one 1000 feet deep and the other 750 feet deep along with a PVC pipeline.
3. Though the petitioner had raised objections to the notification for acquiring the land, the same was rejected and the land was acquired.
The petitioner would submit that the second respondent had passed an award without duly considering the nature of the property, its usufructs thereon and its location.
4. Challenging the said award, the petitioner had filed a claim petition before the first respondent on 04.07.2023.
Though over a year and a half has passed, the first respondent has not taken up the claim petition for enquiry.
Aggrieved by this, the petitioner has moved this Court.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.

Considering the request and taking note of the facts of the case, a mandamus is issued to the first respondent to dispose of the petitioner's claim petition filed on 04.07.2023, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
6.
With the above direction, this writ petition is allowed.
No costs.
